description:
Clear one hit as not-a-threat. Reversible — it moves to the Cleared list.

    Takes `jurisdiction` and `app_no` exactly as they appear on a conflict from
    my_conflicts. Use it when the user says a hit is fine — an unrelated business, a
    different sector, their own filing — so the desk stops surfacing it.
name: dismiss_conflict
title: Clear a conflict as not a threat
